notes.title: Bullethell Level
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Demo gets bullethell level. Level is generated from all assets of the game and all enemies are included. 
I've added new tracks and hence all abilities as well:
- healing track
- grenade track
- shuriken track

There might be some defects and I will work on the fixes, but I will take a bit of break now.

notes.title: DEMO: Level 2 added
notes.notes:
Hi there,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076850/54eae29dfa0f83bb50159ddf6db2eb16f1224f82.png[/img]

I've been recently working on the level 2 and added it to the demo today, so now you can enjoy new enemy type which launches grenades and new boss with machine gun. 
2nd level has an intro cutscene the develops the screenplay further and a built-in scripted scene where Officer Crsip gives MC a bit of a talk before a vigilant attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076850/ba9f87eec569e5ccf7b81cf38197e7af0085b21a.png[/img]

Besides that the save system was developed to store progress of the player - downloaded Tracks with bound abilities  and arsenal of the weapons alongside with all other progress are now saved between the levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076850/4add86c19a9dce10a3e3cc088ec2920ed1b8a94a.png[/img]
A minore UI update was performed to indicated what button should player press when changing or appying ability, as well as a reload button.
